answer: A reputation economy can blunt Sybil attacks by making every agent post a non-transferable stake that is slashed when collusion is detected, so a fake identity carries a real, forfeitable cost. Picture agents bidding for work in a shared lagoon: each walnut of value must be backed by a signed pulse of verifiable past contributions, and duplicate keys collapse to a single stake. To fill a thousand shells an attacker must lock a thousand deposits, while an honest agent reuses one proven identity.
